title: Velocimetric Study of Temporal Arteries in Patients With Horton Disease Using Scan-Doppler
brief_summary: The use of ultrasonography in detecting giant cell arteritis ( GCA) is emerging. Currently, temporal biopsy is the gold standard to diagnose GCA but studies have shown the interest to use B mode ultrasonography. However, until now, the study of velocities in GCA have not been yet performed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with suspicious giant arteritis

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients who have already been treated or diagnosed for giant arteritis
study_population: all patients aged more than 55 years old who are suspected of giant arteritis
